name: What factors drive the cost of finishing a garage interior?

mainEntity.name: What factors drive the cost of finishing a garage interior?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost depends on your starting point, whether the studs are bare, and what features you want to add. Key cost factors include insulating exterior walls, drywall square footage, electrical needs for power tools or EV chargers, and the level of trim work. Basic drywall hanging, taping, and painting cost considerably less than converting the room into a heated hobby shop with custom cabinetry. Because labor is coordinated directly on-site by our lead contractor, you avoid middleman markup on core carpentry and painting tasks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on whether walls are already framed, insulation needs, drywall square footage, electrical rough-ins, and custom carpentry like storage or trim.
